reply.emotion: parched and dry-throated, craving a cold glass of water
notes: Unlike English, Italian uses the verb avere (to have) rather than essere (to be) to express this physical sensation, just as with avere fame (to be hungry).

senses.definition: To feel a need or desire to drink something.

examples.text: Dopo la corsa sotto il sole, ho molta sete.
examples.translation: After the run under the sun, I am very thirsty.
examples.emotion: exhausted and panting from the heat, desperately needing water

definitions: To feel a need or desire to drink something.
